name: godaddy-account-management
description: Full access to your own GoDaddy account from Claude, using your Personal Access Token: list and inspect domains, add, change and delete DNS records, check availability, and register, renew or re-point domains (actions that can charge your account). Community project, not affiliated with GoDaddy.

godaddy_pat.title: GoDaddy Personal Access Token
godaddy_pat.description: Create one at https://developer.godaddy.com/personal-access-token with the domains.domain:read, domains.dns:update, domains.domain:create and domains.nameserver:update scopes.

api_base_url.title: GoDaddy API
api_base_url.description: GoDaddy API base URL: https://api.godaddy.com (production, default) or https://api.ote-godaddy.com (GoDaddy's OTE test environment, no real charges).
